content:
A port of the fantastic patch by @wyrdal 'macrosynth' using pd~ subprocess for multicore.

A polyphonic synth module based on Mutable Instrument’s Plaits, using this PD external port by Javier Nonis:
https://github.com/jnonis/pd-plaits

For Organelle M & S.

Backwards compatible with previously saved presets, just delete the original 'macrosynth' folder and rename this folder from 'macrosynth-pd' to 'macrosynth'.

Changelog:
v1.1 - Fixed bug with LFO speed and type not responding.
v1.2 - Fixed tuning inconsistency.
v1.3 - Fixed typo in parameter "mod_morph".
